title.quote:
HiFormer: Hierarchical Multi-scale Representations Using Transformers for
Medical Image Segmentation

extractions.description: This paper introduces HiFormer, a novel hybrid CNN-transformer-based method for medical image segmentation. It combines global features from a Swin Transformer module with local representations of a CNN-based encoder, using a Double-Level Fusion (DLF) module for finer feature fusion. The method achieves superior performance over CNN-based, transformer-based, and hybrid models in medical image segmentation tasks.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is focused on medical image segmentation, which is not directly related to sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote:
Medical image segmentation is one of the main challenges in computer vision, which provides valuable information about the areas of anatomy needed for a detailed
analysis. This information can greatly assist doctors in depicting injuries, monitoring disease progression, and assess-ing the need for appropriate treatment. As a result of the growing use of medical image analysis, highly precise and
robust segmentation has become increasingly vital.
